frontMatter.welcome:
Welcome to Excel Industries Limited, a trusted name in the Indian chemical manufacturing sector with a legacy of innovation, integrity, and operational excellence.
As you begin your professional journey with Excel Industries Limited, you become part of an organization committed to responsible growth, scientific rigor, and long-term value creation. Our success is driven by our people, our ethical practices, and our commitment to safety, sustainability, and quality across all operations.
This Employee Handbook has been prepared to help you understand our workplace culture, employment practices, and organizational expectations, and to support you throughout your tenure with the company.
frontMatter.about:
Excel Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacture of industrial chemicals, specialty chemicals, agrochemical intermediates, and pharmaceutical intermediates, serving both domestic and international markets.
Our operations are supported by:
- A disciplined approach to safety, quality, and environmental stewardship.
At Excel Industries Limited, our purpose is to conduct business responsibly while delivering value to customers, employees, and stakeholders.
We are guided by the following principles:
- Safety First – Protecting people, processes, and the environment
- Integrity & Ethics – Conducting business transparently and lawfully
- Operational Excellence – Consistency, discipline, and quality in execution
- People Development – Encouraging learning, capability building, and engagement
- Sustainability & Responsibility – Minimizing environmental impact and promoting long-term value.
This Employee Handbook serves as a practical reference to help you:
- Understand company policies and employment practices
- Know your rights, responsibilities, and workplace standards
- Navigate HR processes, benefits, and support systems
- Align your conduct with company values and statutory requirements
This Employee Handbook applies to:
- All permanent, probationary, contractual, and trainee employees of Excel Industries Limited
- All operational and administrative locations of the company
- Employment-related interactions within company premises and during official duties.

frontMatter.purpose:
At Excel Industries Limited, operational excellence is achieved through fair working conditions, regulatory compliance, and respect for employee well-being. Clearly defined working hours, transparent attendance practices, lawful flexibility, and disciplined conduct are essential to maintaining a safe, productive, and respectful workplace across all operations.
This section of the Employee Handbook outlines general practices related to working hours, attendance management, flexibility, and employee conduct, in accordance with applicable labour laws and internal HR policies.

chapters.title: Working Hours & Attendance Management
chapters.text:
## Standard Working Hours:
Working hours vary based on role, function, and operational requirements. Employees will be informed of their applicable shift schedule by their respective department.
[table]
| Shift Type | Corporate / R&D | Manufacturing Units |
| General Shift | 09:00 – 18:00 | 09:00 – 17:30 |
| Shift I | As notified | 06:00 – 14:00 |
| Shift II | As notified | 14:00 – 22:00 |
| Shift III | As notified | 22:00 – 06:00 |
Note: Shift timings may vary by site, department, or operational requirement. Employees must strictly adhere to their assigned schedules.
## Key Working Hour Guidelines
- Employees are expected to report on time for their assigned shifts.
- Statutory rest breaks are provided in accordance with applicable labour laws.
- Overtime work, where applicable, is permitted only with prior approval and is compensated as per law.
- Repeated late arrivals, early departures, or unapproved absences may lead to disciplinary action.
## Attendance Management System
## Biometric Attendance
- All employees, contract workers, and applicable on-site personnel are required to record attendance through biometric systems installed at designated entry and exit points.
- Attendance data is automatically integrated into the HR attendance and payroll system.
- Employees must ensure that both in-time and out-time are recorded accurately.
## Attendance Data Security
- Biometric and attendance data are handled securely and accessed only by authorized HR personnel.
- Employees may view their attendance records through designated HR systems.
- In case of system malfunction, employees must inform HR immediately and follow the prescribed manual recording process.
## Attendance Expectations & Discipline
## Punctuality and Presence
- Regular and punctual attendance is essential for operational continuity and team coordination.
- Unauthorized absences or habitual tardiness may attract progressive disciplinary action.
## Disciplinary Actions for Attendance Violations
- First Instance: Verbal counselling
- Second Instance: Written warning
- Repeated Violations: Salary deduction, suspension, or further disciplinary action
- Continuous unauthorized absence beyond the prescribed limit may result in termination, in line with company policy and applicable law.
## Falsification of Attendance
Any attempt to manipulate, falsify, or misuse attendance records—including biometric misuse—is treated as serious misconduct and may result in strict disciplinary action, including termination.
## Work Hour Flexibility
## Flexibility Overview
Excel Industries Limited recognizes that limited flexibility may be required for certain roles. However, flexibility arrangements are exception-based, role-dependent, and subject to management and HR approval.
## Work-from-Home (WFH) Guidelines
- WFH is permitted only for eligible roles where productivity, safety, data security, and compliance are not compromised.
- All WFH arrangements require prior approval from the Reporting Manager and HR.
- Business requirements take precedence, and employees may be required to report to the workplace as needed.
- WFH privileges may be modified or withdrawn at management discretion.
## Technical & Security Requirements
- Employees working remotely must use company-approved devices only.
- All IT, information security, and data protection protocols must be strictly followed.
- The company is not responsible for personal internet connectivity or home infrastructure costs.
- Confidential information must be handled strictly as per company IT and information security policies.
## Work-from-Home (WFH) Arrangements
## Termination or Modification of WFH
- Excel Industries Limited reserves the right to modify or discontinue WFH arrangements at any time based on business, operational, or compliance requirements.
- Managers may require employees to report to the workplace whenever necessary.
- WFH is a privilege, not an entitlement, and is subject to ongoing performance and business needs.
## Security and Confidentiality During Remote Work
## Employees working remotely must:
- Safeguard all company information, documents, and systems.
- Ensure confidential information is not shared, copied, or accessed by unauthorized individuals.
- Return or securely dispose of confidential materials as per company guidelines.
- Use only company-issued devices and comply with IT and data protection policies.
Failure to comply with these requirements may result in disciplinary action.
## Work Time, Flexibility & Compensation
## Work Time and Registration
- Employees must work strictly in accordance with assigned working hours and shift schedules.
- All work time must comply with applicable labour laws and internal policies.
- WFH or flexible work arrangements must be registered through the HR system with prior approval.
- On-site attendance is recorded via biometric systems; remote work attendance is recorded as per HR guidelines.
## Responsibilities of Managers

chapters.title: Overtime Compensation
chapters.text:
- Overtime wages are paid at twice (2x) the ordinary rate of wages, in line with the Factories Act and applicable State labour laws.
- Work on weekly offs or notified holidays is also compensated at 2x, unless governed otherwise by wage settlements or statutory notifications.
- Night shift allowances and special allowances are paid as per unit-specific HR circulars or settlements.
- Overtime details are communicated through payroll statements or HR circulars.
## nternal Compliance & Audits
## To ensure fairness and accuracy:
- Attendance and overtime records are reviewed monthly by HR/Admin.
- Employees receive periodic summaries highlighting attendance, overtime, leave balances, and discrepancies.
## Attendance & Overtime Violations
- First Instance: Verbal counselling
- Second Instance: Written warning
- Repeated Violations: Salary deduction, suspension, or disciplinary action
- Any falsification or manipulation of attendance or overtime records will result in strict disciplinary action, including termination.
## Fair & Adequate Wage Management
Excel Industries Limited is committed to ensuring fair, responsible, and legally compliant compensation practices.
## Key practices include:
- Annual compensation reviews based on role, performance, experience, and market benchmarks.
- Consideration of cost of living, inflation, and statutory wage revisions.
- Use of government data and credible external benchmarks.
- Periodic adjustments to maintain internal equity and competitiveness.
This approach supports employee well-being, motivation, and long-term retention.
## Family-Friendly Plans
## Paid Leave Benefits
Excel Industries Limited provides structured leave benefits to support employee well-being, work–life balance, and statutory compliance. Leave entitlements are administered in accordance with company policy and applicable labour laws.
[table]
| Leave Type | Entitlement | Usage Rules | Accumulation / Encashment |
| Earned Leave (EL) | 15 days annually after completion of 1 year of service | Minimum 3 days per application (excluding Sundays) | Accumulates up to 30 days (Units) / 60 days (Corporate Office); excess may be en |
| Casual Leave (CL) | 7 days (Units) / 12 days (Corporate Office) annually | Minimum 1 day, maximum 3 days per instance; holidays may be adjacent but not bot | Cannot be accumulated or encashed; lapses at calendar year-end |
| Sick Leave (SL) | 7 days (Units) / 12 days (Corporate Office) annually (for non-ESIC employees) | Medical certificate required if leave exceeds 3 consecutive days; may be combine | Accumulates up to 30 days; excess lapses |
| Maternity Leave | As per the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 | — |
| Compensatory Off | Earned for approved overtime beyond shift hours | Maximum 2 days can be availed per month | Expires 90 days from the date of credit |
| Holidays | Up to 12 paid holidays per year | As per State Government holiday list | — |
## General Guidelines
- Unauthorized absence is treated as Leave Without Pay (LWP).
- Continuous unexplained absence of 8 or more days may result in disciplinary action, including termination.
- Leave balances are updated annually on 1st January.
- Leave-related queries are handled through the HR helpdesk or designated HR contact.
## Health Care Coverage
Excel Industries Limited is committed to supporting the health and well-being of employees and their families through structured insurance coverage.
## Medical Insurance Coverage
- All full-time employees are enrolled in the Group Medical Insurance (GMI) policy from the date of joining, subject to policy terms.
- Coverage typically includes:
- In-patient hospitalization and approved day-care procedures
- Out-patient consultations, diagnostics, and pharmacy benefits (as per insurer policy)
- Surgical procedures
- Maternity benefits
- Emergency ambulance services
Details of coverage limits, inclusions, and exclusions are communicated separately by HR or the insurance provider.
## Bonus Scheme & Performance Rewards
## Annual Performance Bonus
- Employees become eligible for the annual performance bonus upon completion of one full financial year of service.
- Bonus determination is based on:
- Individual performance appraisal (KPIs and goal achievement)
- Departmental contribution
- Overall company performance and profitability
[table]
| Performance Rating | Bonus Eligibility (% of Base Salary) |
| Outstanding Performer | 15% – 25% |
| Exceeds Expectations | 10% – 15% |
| Meets Expectations | 5% – 10% |
| Below Expectations | Not eligible |
- Annual bonuses are generally disbursed with the April payroll, subject to management approval.
## Other Reward Programs
## Spot Recognition & Team Bonuses
- Spot Awards ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹10,000 for exceptional performance
- Team Success Bonuses for cross-functional teams achieving key milestones
## Festival & Loyalty Bonuses
- Festival Bonus: Fixed ₹5,000 for confirmed employees (subject to policy eligibility)

chapters.title: Learning & Development Framework
chapters.text:
- Excel Industries provides access to a mix of internal and external training programs, including:
- Technical and functional training relevant to manufacturing, R&D, quality, EHS, and operations
- Compliance, safety, ethics, and statutory training (mandatory)
- Leadership and supervisory development programs
- Digital skills and process improvement tools, where applicable
- Training programs may be delivered through classroom sessions, on-the-job training, workshops, or virtual platforms, depending on business needs.
## Mandatory Training
Certain training programs are mandatory for all or specific categories of employees, including:
- Safety, health, and environment (EHS)
- Code of Conduct and Business Ethics
- Quality and regulatory compliance
- Information security and data protection (where applicable)
## Skill Development & Upskilling:
- Excel Industries encourages employees to continuously enhance their skills through:
- Technical specialization related to their roles
- Development of soft skills such as communication, teamwork, and problem-solving
- Cross-functional exposure through project assignments or job rotations, subject to operational feasibility.
- Support for external training, certifications, or professional development programs may be provided based on role relevance, performance, and management approval.
## ndividual Development Plans (IDPs):
Individual Development Plans are used as a structured tool to support employee growth.
[table]
| Element | Description |
| Goal Setting | Development goals aligned with role requirements and business objectives |
| Review Mechanism | Periodic discussions during performance reviews |
| Development Support | Training, mentoring, or on-the-job exposure |
| Flexibility | Updated based on role changes or skill needs |
## Career Counselling & Guidance
## Counselling Services:
- Employees may seek career guidance through discussions with their reporting manager or HR.
- Career discussions may cover:
- Role expectations and progression paths
- Skill gaps and development needs
- Readiness for expanded responsibilities or future roles
- Career-related discussions form part of the annual performance review process.
To strengthen awareness and accountability, Excel Industries Limited conducts regular training programs covering:
- Anti-discrimination and workplace conduct
- Prevention of harassment and respectful behavior
- Sensitization toward diversity and inclusion
- Unconscious bias awareness for managers and supervisors
- Legal obligations under labour and employment laws
These trainings are conducted during onboarding and refreshed annually.
## Roles & Responsibilities
## Every employee is expected to:
- Treat colleagues, contractors, and stakeholders with respect
- Avoid discriminatory language or behavior
- Report concerns or violations through established grievance channels
- Participate in mandatory DEI and workplace conduct training
## Managers and Leaders are responsible for:
- Demonstrating inclusive leadership behaviors
- Ensuring fair treatment within teams
- Addressing concerns promptly and objectively
- Encouraging diverse perspectives in decision-making
- Ensuring participation in mandatory training programs
## Reporting & Accountability
Any instance of discrimination, harassment, or exclusion may be reported through:
- Reporting Manager
- HR Department
- Internal grievance or POSH mechanisms
All complaints are handled confidentially, fairly, and without retaliation, in accordance with company policy and legal requirements.
## Our Commitment Going Forward
Excel Industries Limited remains committed to strengthening diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous review, employee engagement, and leadership accountability—ensuring a workplace where everyone can contribute, grow, and succeed.
## Harassment & Discrimination Prevention
At Excel Industries Limited, every employee has the right to work in an environment that is safe, dignified, and free from harassment, discrimination, or intimidation. We maintain a zero-tolerance approach toward any conduct that undermines individual dignity, mutual respect, or professional integrity.
This policy supports our commitment to ethical conduct, human rights, and compliance with applicable labour laws, including the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013.
## Scope
This policy applies to:
- All permanent, temporary, contractual, trainee, and probationary employees
- Contractors, consultants, vendors, and service providers
- Visitors and third parties interacting with Excel Industries Limited
- Conduct occurring on company premises, client locations, during business travel, virtual platforms, or work-related events.
## Definitions
[table]
| Type | Description / Examples |
| Harassment | Unwelcome verbal, physical, visual, or digital conduct that creates an intimidat |

chapters.title: Performance Appraisal & Feedback
chapters.text:
- The appraisal cycle operates on an annual basis as defined by HR.
- Eligibility, timelines, and increment applicability are communicated separately through HR circulars.
- Performance assessment is based on:
- Achievement of role-specific goals and KPIs
- Adherence to company values and behavioral expectations
- Learning initiatives and skill development efforts
- Performance feedback is intended to be constructive, transparent, and growth-oriented.
## nternal Career Mobility
## Career Mobility Pathways:
[table]
| Mobility Type | Description | Key Features & Eligibility |
| Vertical Career Growth | Progression within the same function to higher roles with increased responsibili | Defined career ladders across Manufacturing, R&D, Quality, Engineering, Supply C |
| Horizontal Career Movement | Lateral movement across functions to broaden skills and gain cross-functional ex | Movement across departments such as Production, Quality, Supply Chain, EHS, R&D, |
| Transversal / Cross-Functional Assignments | Temporary assignment to strategic or project-based roles outside the employee’s  | Participation in cross-functional projects, digital initiatives, sustainability  |
## nternal Job Postings (IJP)
- All vacancies are posted internally 2 weeks before external hiring
- Employees can apply through the Excel HR Portal using skill and interest filters.
## Performance Improvement Support
Where performance gaps are identified:
- A structured Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) may be initiated.
- The objective of PIP is to support improvement through:
- Clear performance expectations
- Coaching, training, or mentoring
- Periodic review meetings
Outcomes of a PIP are based on progress demonstrated during the defined review period.
## Roles & Responsibilities
- Employees: Take ownership of learning, development, and performance improvement.
- Reporting Managers: Provide guidance, feedback, and development opportunities.
- Human Resources: Facilitate training programs, performance systems, and career discussions.
## Career Progression Framework
## Objective
At Excel Industries Limited, career progression is designed to recognize sustained performance, skill enhancement, leadership capability, and alignment with organizational requirements. Promotions are granted through a structured, merit-based, and transparent process to ensure fairness, consistency, and long-term organizational effectiveness.
This framework supports employee motivation while ensuring that role progression aligns with business needs, safety, quality, and regulatory responsibilities across manufacturing and corporate functions.
## Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible for promotion, an employee must meet the following conditions:
- Have completed at least 12 months in their current role.
- Not be under a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) at the time of review.
- Achievement of a minimum performance rating of “Meets Expectations” or equivalent in the most recent appraisal cycle.
- Demonstrated ability to handle expanded responsibilities, technical complexity, or leadership scope.
- Fulfilment of role-specific qualifications, certifications, or statutory requirements, where applicable.
Note : Employees who join after 30th September of the appraisal year will generally be considered for promotion in the subsequent appraisal cycle.
Career progression at Excel Industries Limited is directly linked to the Performance Management System (PMS):
- The PMS cycle follows the financial year (April–March).
- Performance is assessed through goal setting, KPI achievement, competency evaluation, and behavioral assessment.
- Employees with consistently strong performance outcomes are considered for promotion, subject to position availability and organizational structure.
## Promotion Process
Promotion decisions follow a defined approval workflow:
- Manager Recommendation : The reporting manager evaluates the employee’s readiness for progression based on performance, skill depth, safety and compliance adherence, and operational requirements.
- HR Validation : HR reviews eligibility, verifies appraisal outcomes, ensures internal equity, and confirms policy compliance.
- Department Head Approval : The respective Functional or Department Head reviews and approves the recommendation. Senior management approval may be required for critical or leadership roles.
- Formal Communication : Approved promotions are formally communicated by the HR Department, specifying the effective date, revised designation, and applicable compensation changes.
Note: Promotions are typically processed during the annual appraisal cycle. However, off-cycle promotions may be approved in exceptional cases such as role expansion, critical skill requirements, or significant business contributions.
## Performance Improvement & Promotion Hold
- Employees placed under a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) are not eligible for promotion during the PIP period

chapters.title: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
chapters.text:
## ntroduction
At Excel Industries Limited, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every employee is treated with dignity, fairness, and respect. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable business growth.
Our DEI approach ensures equal opportunity across all employment practices and reinforces our commitment to ethical conduct, human rights, and responsible business practices.
## Our Commitment
Excel Industries Limited is dedicated to:
- Providing equal opportunity in recruitment, training, promotion, and compensation
- Maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and bias
- Ensuring fairness in decision-making, performance management, and career development
- Respecting individual differences across gender, age, disability, ethnicity, religion, caste, marital status, or any legally protected characteristic
All DEI commitments are implemented in line with applicable labour laws, constitutional principles, and regulatory requirements, and are integrated into the company’s ESG and governance framework
## nclusive Workplace Culture:
Excel Industries Limited promotes inclusion through structured and transparent practices:
- Fair and objective recruitment and promotion processes
- Equal access to training, internal job opportunities, and leadership development programs
- Non-discriminatory workplace policies and grievance redressal mechanisms
- Structured mentorship and development support for early-career employees
- Regular review of HR policies to ensure alignment with diversity and equity principles.
## Accessibility & Workplace Accommodations:
We strive to provide a supportive and accessible work environment for all employees
- Physical workplace accessibility at offices and manufacturing sites, where feasible
- Reasonable workplace accommodations for employees with disabilities or medical needs
- Flexible work arrangements in eligible roles, subject to operational requirements
- Confidential accommodation requests handled by HR with sensitivity and privacy
- Periodic review of facilities and policies to improve accessibility.
## Gender Equity & Equal Opportunity
Excel Industries Limited is committed to promoting gender equity across all levels of the organization:
- Equal opportunity in recruitment, training, promotion, and leadership roles
- Zero tolerance toward sexual harassment, in line with the POSH Act
- Supportive policies for maternity, childcare, and work-life balance
- Encouragement of women’s participation in technical, operational, and leadership roles
- Regular monitoring of gender representation and advancement trends.
## Fair & Equitable Compensation
Excel Industries Limited follows a structured and transparent compensation framework:
[table]
| What We Ensure | How We Implement It |
| Equal Pay for Equal Work | Role-based evaluation and job grading |
| No Unfair Wage Disparity | Periodic internal and external benchmarking |
| Objective Compensation Decisions | Performance- and responsibility-linked pay |
| Consistent Incentives | Standardized bonus and reward criteria |
| Transparency | Clear communication through HR systems |
Compensation decisions are based on role complexity, performance, experience, and business requirements, not personal identity.

chapters.title: Disciplinary Action
chapters.text:
Violations result in corrective measures up to and including termination of employment, contract cancellation, or legal action. Severity is determined by the facts of each case and prior conduct.
## Continuous Improvement
Data from incident reports (de-identified), employee-engagement surveys, and audit findings are reviewed quarterly by the DE&I Council to:
- Identify hotspots or systemic issues
- Update training content and communication strategies
- Recommend policy refinements to senior leadership
## Whistleblower Protocol
## ntroduction
At Excel Industries Limited, integrity, transparency, and ethical conduct are fundamental to the way we operate. The Company is committed to maintaining the highest standards of corporate governance and ethical behavior across all levels of the organization.
This Whistleblower Protocol provides a structured, confidential, and secure mechanism for employees and other stakeholders to report concerns related to unethical conduct, misconduct, violations of law, or company policies—without fear of retaliation.
This protocol supports Excel Industries Limited’s commitments toward:
- Ethical business conduct
- Anti-corruption and fraud prevention
- Responsible information management
- ESG and regulatory compliance
## What Can Be Reported
Whistleblowers are encouraged to report any suspected or actual wrongdoing, including but not limited to:
## Anti-Corruption Violations
- Bribery or Facilitation Payments: Offering, giving, or accepting any undue advantage to influence decisions
- Kickbacks & Embezzlement: Unlawful payments or misappropriation of company assets
- Conflict of Interest: Undisclosed personal interest influencing business decisions
- Gifts or Hospitality: Acceptance or offering of items that could improperly influence behavior
- Fraud: Falsifying documents, data, or financial results for gain
- Money Laundering: Engaging in financial transactions intended to disguise the origins of illegally obtained funds.
- Nepotism and Favoritism: Granting unfair advantage in recruitment, promotion, or contracting due to personal relationships.
## nformation Management Breaches
- Unauthorized Access or Disclosure: Sharing confidential or sensitive company or stakeholder data
- Cybersecurity Violations: Phishing, malware attacks, or breach of IT security protocols
- Improper Data Handling: Mishandling of personal, financial, R&D, or ESG-related information
- Falsification of Records: Tampering with audit trails, ESG metrics, or financial accounts
- Violation of Privacy Regulations: Non-compliance with data protection laws (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) including failure to obtain consent or improper data storage.
- Use of Unlicensed or Pirated Software: Installing or distributing software without valid licensing.
- Improper Use of Communication Channels: Using company systems for spreading misinformation, offensive content, or personal gain.
## Workplace Conduct Violations
- Harassment or Bullying: Verbal, physical, or psychological abuse of colleagues or subordinates.
- Discrimination: Unfair treatment based on gender, caste, religion, disability, age, or any protected characteristic.
- Retaliation: Punishing an employee for reporting misconduct or cooperating in an investigation.
- Substance Abuse: Possession or use of alcohol, narcotics, or other controlled substances at the workplace.
## Compliance & Regulatory Breaches
- Insider Trading: Using non-public information to trade in securities.
- Violation of Environmental Laws: Improper disposal of waste, emissions violations, or lack of required permits.
- Health & Safety Violations: Ignoring or bypassing safety protocols, leading to risk of injury.
- Non-compliance with Labour Laws: Breach of wage, working hours, or contract employment laws.
## Social Media & Public Representation
- Inappropriate Public Statements: Sharing confidential or negative information about the company in public forums.
- Unauthorized Interviews or Media Access: Speaking on behalf of the company without approval.
- Defamation of Company or Colleagues: Damaging reputation through false claims online or offline
## Our Commitments
- Zero Tolerance for Corruption: No form of bribery, kickback, or fraudulent practice is accepted
- Strict Data Governance: We adhere to ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, and relevant data privacy regulations
- Non-Retaliation Assurance: Whistleblowers are protected from retaliation or adverse consequences
- Transparency & Accountability: All complaints are investigated fairly and documented thoroughly
## Reporting Channels
Stakeholders may choose from several secure, confidential, and anonymous methods:
[table]
| Channel | Details |
| Confidential Email | ethics.whistleblower@excelind.co.in |
| Third-Party Ethics Hotline | +91-22-66464200 (Available 24/7, multilingual) |
| Written Complaint | Sealed envelope marked “Confidential – Whistleblower” addressed to Ethics Commit |
…

chapters.title: Grievance Mechanism
chapters.text:
## ntroduction
Excel Industries Limited is committed to maintaining a fair, transparent, and respectful workplace where concerns and grievances are addressed promptly, objectively, and without fear of retaliation.
The Company has established a structured Grievance Redressal Mechanism to enable employees and other stakeholders to raise concerns related to employment conditions, workplace conduct, ethics, human rights, environmental practices, and regulatory compliance.
This mechanism reflects Excel Industries Limited’s commitment to:
- Ethical business conduct
- Compliance with applicable labour and environmental laws
- Respect for human rights and dignity
- Continuous improvement in workplace practices.
## Scope of Grievances
Grievances may be raised for, but are not limited to, the following concerns:
- Labor Practices & Working Conditions: Excessive working hours, forced labor, child labor, discrimination, harassment, or unfair wages.
- Health, Safety & Wellbeing: Unsafe work environments, exposure to hazardous substances, denial of protective equipment.
- Ethical Business Conduct: Bribery, corruption, conflict of interest, facilitation payments, or any breach of the Company’s Code of Conduct.
- Human Rights: Violations impacting individuals or communities, including land rights, freedom of association, or abuse in the supply chain.
- Environmental Concerns: Improper waste disposal, air/water pollution, ecosystem damage, and failure to meet environmental compliance.
- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DE&I): Any exclusionary practices based on gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, disability, or other protected characteristics.
- Supply Chain Violations: Involvement of vendors or subcontractors in unethical practices such as modern slavery, illegal sourcing, or ESG violations.
- Transparency & ESG Reporting: Falsification or concealment of ESG data, impact assessments, or audit results.
## Reporting Channels
To promote accessibility and confidentiality, Excel provides the following grievance channels:
- 24/7 Ethics Hotline – Toll-free number available in multiple languages
- Online Grievance Form – www.ethics.ethicsportal.com (anonymous reporting enabled)
- Grievance Box – Available at all manufacturing, warehousing, and project locations
- Community Liaison Desk – During stakeholder consultations or public hearings
- Email – humanrights@excel.in
## Redressal Process
Excel Industries Limited follows a tiered grievance resolution process:
## Level 01 – Supervisor Level
- Grievance submitted in writing to the immediate supervisor
- Acknowledgement: within 1 working day
- Resolution Timeline: 2 working days
- If unresolved, escalated to Level 02
## Level 02 – Grievance Officer
- Complaint submitted to designated Grievance Officer
- Acknowledgement: within 1 working day
- Counseling and investigation: within 3 working days
- If unsatisfactory, escalated to Level 03
## Level 03 – Grievance Redressal Committee
- Formal complaint lodged with Grievance Redressal Committee (comprising one Functional Director, one HR representative, and the Company Secretary)
- Deliberation and Recommendation: within 7 working days
- Final Decision by Management: within a maximum of 14 working days
## Remediation & Follow-up
Where grievances are found to be valid, Excel Industries Limited will take proportionate and fair corrective actions, which may include:
[table]
| Remediation Stage | Action |
| Immediate Relief | Cease any ongoing harm and ensure safety of the complainant |
| Support Services | Legal assistance, counseling, or rehabilitation in partnership with NGOs |
| Restitution | Financial or operational compensation, as applicable |
| Disciplinary Action | Suspension or removal of employee/vendor as per Code of Conduct |
| Disclosure | Transparent sharing of grievance outcomes (where permitted by law) |
| Stakeholder Engagement | Rebuilding trust with affected stakeholders through dialogue |
## Confidentiality & Non-Retaliation
- All grievances are handled with strict confidentiality
- Retaliation against any individual raising a grievance in good faith is strictly prohibited
- Any retaliation will attract disciplinary action under the Company’s Code of Conduct
## Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
To strengthen effectiveness, Excel Industries Limited will:
- Periodically review grievance trends
- Conduct internal audits and assessments
- Update internal risk registers and controls
- Provide training on grievance handling and employee rights
- Review this mechanism annually for relevance and effectiveness
## Reporting & Governance
- The Grievance Redressal Committee shall submit an annual summary report to Management
- The report includes number, category, resolution status, and improvement actions
- Learnings are used to strengthen governance, ESG performance, and workplace culture
## Remediation Processes
